messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "discontinue this medication if eGFR falls below 30 mL/minute/1.73 m2"
set: ["discontinue this medication if eGFR falls below 30 mL/minute/1.73 m2", "assess risk/benefit of continuing if eGFR falls below 45 mL/minute/1.73 m2", "discontinue treatment after reduction", "if device falls off, call healthcare provider", "discontinue treatment in early spring", "if you are being treated for high blood pressure, keep using this medication", "contact your healthcare provider if you experience widespread, severe itching on stopping this medication", "start at 25 mg every other day if eGFR is between 30 and 50 due to higher risk of high potassium", "this applies if you also use an oral steroid medication when you start taking montelukast", "talk to your doctor if this occurs", "call your healthcare provider if this happens", "do this even if you feel well", "if you have switched from another anxiety medication", "use medication regularly", "get medical help straight away if this happens", "take with food if the medication upsets your stomach"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
